phantomCorrection: Initial fit used upper, abdominal and leg arterial bases with equal territory weights. Current revision retains upper activity at one third and combines abdomen/legs with continuous concentration; source-derived pelvic main paths are smoothed and secondary branches reduced before 3D projection. No patient pixels are included.
geometryRevision: icrp-continuous-lower-perfusion-v3: exploratory teaching appearance. Fit errors below describe the previous v2 geometry, not a validation of this revision. The 9-second transit parameter is retained.

kineticFit.limitations: Relative planar appearance only, not blood clearance. Injection times missing. ROI geometry, pathology, bolus, attenuation and subject motion can affect contrast. Clinical pixels stay local; synthetic anatomy is not patient-matched.

scope: Exploratory relative appearance fit; not clinical validation or absolute pharmacokinetic calibration. No local focal uptake, hardware pattern or injection-site activity is transferred to the generic phantom.
